# Kyosei

> Kyosei (共生) is a provenance-first task board for software built by a person and coding
> agents together. Its CLI, `kyo`, keeps a project's ideas, records and evidence in a git-backed
> store, generates the brief each agent works from, and enforces its rules through Claude Code
> hooks.

Two kinds of agent visit this repository. If you were asked to **use Kyosei in a project**,
install the CLI with `uv tool install kyosei`, then run `kyo onboard` inside that project and
follow the setup prompt it prints. If you were asked to **work on Kyosei itself**, read
AGENTS.md first.

## Use Kyosei in my project

- [Getting started](docs/guide/04-getting-started.md): install `kyo`, run `kyo onboard`, and what `kyo init` does in an empty folder or an existing project
- [Setup decisions](docs/guide/setup-decisions.md): every question setup asks, with its default and the reason for it
- [Install and upgrading](docs/reference/topics/install.md): the Claude Code plugin (`kyo harness install claude-code`, the default) or the tracked copies (`--copies`), moving a project to the plugin with `kyo harness migrate`, and what an upgrade needs on each route
- [Prior-art search](docs/guide/06-kinds-scopes-documents.md#prior-art-search): the optional extra `kyosei[recx]`, which searches recx's index of published repositories when a proposal is created, off until a project turns it on
- [Docs governance](docs/reference/topics/docs-governance.md): documents that name the code they describe, including a recx manifest (`RECX.yaml`) governed module by module
- [The operator's guide](docs/guide/README.md): what Kyosei is, records, sessions and hooks, dispatching, kinds, and machine layouts, in reading order
- [Command reference](docs/reference/cli.md): every `kyo` command and flag, generated from the CLI

## Work on Kyosei

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): building, testing and contributing; the venv rules and the store rules for dispatched workers
- [Design charter](docs/design/charter.md): the laws, the architecture and the reasoning behind them
- [Desktop app](apps/desktop/README.md): the Electron viewer that reads projects through `kyo serve`, built from source with its own checks

## Optional

- [README](README.md): the front page: what Kyosei is, installing, and where to go next

- [Topic references](docs/reference/topics/): one page per mechanism, in depth
